scope: Official Shopify Impact:Cocoon preset listing View demo inspected read-only with rendered browser accessibility tree. Home, New Arrivals collection, PC Portable Lamp Olive Green PDP and empty cart inspected. No shopper actions, screenshot, viewport/mobile, editor, checkout, keyboard or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Impact:Cocoon listing View demo opened impact-theme-home.myshopify.com.

claims.observed: Home connects designer and room narratives to new arrivals; collection exposes filter, sort and in-stock-only cues with color swatches and ratings.
claims.risk: No collection controls tested; ratings and merchant product data are unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Connect room/occasion stories to taxonomy and keep stock and variant cues current.

claims.observed: Portable lamp PDP presents six color paths, Sold Out state, review link and product-design/LED-life details; empty cart provides Continue shopping.
claims.risk: Inventory, rating, product life-span and product-design claims are not independently verified.
claims.vsn_guard: Make out-of-stock status clear and substantiate durability, LED life and other performance claims.
